messages:
sasha: Quick convo: building the console preview that surfaces per-model AND aggregate token/cost so PMs can guesstimate impact before committing. want to align API fields and UX affordances.

omar: Important: previews must include the sampling window and cache assumptions. otherwise analysts will get confused when numbers drift.

marta: UX suggestion: default to aggregate view, show a small chevron to expand 'split by model'. keep the preview compact. show an orange warning if the split pushes you over route quota.

raj: backend needs stable telemetry tags for each preset: route, model, variant, preview_basis. also include a `preview_id` so traces can join back to a preview run.

sasha: agreed. sketch of response we talked about: 
```json
{
  "preset_id": "ps-1800",
  "route_id": "route-900",
  "aggregate_tokens": "12345",
  "aggregate_cost": "1.23",
  "models": "rwin-1:9000:0.9,rwin-1-quant:3345:0.33",
  "cache_adjustment": "0.2",
  "preview_basis": "7d_hist",
  "preview_id": "preview-987"
}
```

marta: small request: don't return complex nested arrays for models. the UI prefers a CSV-like string (model:tokens:cost) so we can render quickly without parsing deep JSON. backend should still log structured events to telemetry.

omar: agree on CSV-ish payload for the preview API response. but for the saved presets API keep full structured schema. two separate endpoints: "/v1/presets/preview" (UI-friendly) and "/v1/presets" (authoritative).

sasha: rollout behavior: console should offer an opt-in canary (rollout pct) and a fallback policy list. show a short help text: "We recommend <=10% for initial canary."

raj: also surface "confidence" (0-1) for the estimate and a provenance label: historical vs synthetic. add `trace_key: presets.preview.v1` to telemetry so tracing systems can pick it up.

marta: UX note: when user toggles split-by-model, animate the bar chart to avoid jarring reflows. add a hover explaining cache_adj and confidence.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: presets-preview canary scheduled 2025-06-06T04:00:00Z. team: eng-platform.

sasha: I'll PR a minimal mock with the CSV models string and the aggregate/expanded toggle. omar/raj please review naming: `preview_basis`, `cache_adjustment`, `preview_id`.

omar: lgtm. I'll make sure sampling_window is included in server logs.

raj: infra will emit telemetry: `route:<id>`, `preset:<id>`, `preview_id:<id>`, `model:<name>`, `variant:<name>`, `preview_basis:<string>` in the span tags.

sasha: great. syncing Thurs 11am PT to finalize payload and UX microcopy. short thread.
